import networkx as nx
from dimod import BinomialQuadraticModel, sample_ising, BQM, SPINS, simulated_annealing_solver
from qiskit import QuantumCircuit, transpile, assemble, AerSimulator
from qiskit.algorithms import QAOA
from qiskit.transpile import PassManager, Calendar, Transpiler
from qiskit.visualization import plot_histogram, plot_bloch_vector
from scipy.optimize import minimize
import numpy as np

def create_graph(vertices, edges):
    G = nx.Graph()
    G.add_nodes_from(vertices)
    G.add_weighted_edges_from(edges)
    return G

def create_qubo_model(G):
    n = len(G.nodes)
    qvm = BinomialQuadraticModel(n, spins=SPINS)
    for u, v, w in G.edges:
        qvm.set_lin_coeff(u, v, -w)
    return qvm

def solve_qaoa(qvm, p, q):
    bqm = qvm.to_bqm()
    qaoa = QAOA(bqm, p, q)
    optimizer = minimize(qaoa.obj_func, [p, q], method='SLSQP')
    return optimizer.x

def create_qiskit_circuit(n, p, q, optimizer_result):
    qc = QuantumCircuit(n)
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(i, n):
            angle = 2 * np.pi * optimizer_result[i * (n - 1) + j]
            if i == j:
                continue
            qc.ry(angle, i)
            qc.cx(i, j)
        for k in range(p):
            for i in range(n - 1):
                for j in range(i + 1, n):
                    angle = 2 * np.pi * optimizer_result[k * n * (n - 1) + i * (n - 1 - i) + j]
                    qc.ry(angle, i)
                    qc.cx(i, j)
    return qc

def run_simulation(qc, n_shots):
    transpiler = Transpiler(qc)
    cal = Calendar(max_steps=15, max_depth=6)
    pm = PassManager(cal)
    pm.apply(qc)
    assembled_qc = assemble(pm.to_circuit(qc))
    simulator = AerSimulator()
    result = simulator.run(assembled_qc, shots=n_shots)
    return result.get_counts(assembled_qc)

def calculate_cut_value(counts):
    total_count = sum(counts.values())
    max_subsystem_count = max(counts.values())
    cut_value = total_count - 2 * max_subsystem_count
    return cut_value

def solve_drone_swarm_partition():
    graph_vertices = [0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6]
    graph_edges = [[0, 1, 3], [1, 2, 3], [0, 2, 3], [3, 4, 4], [4, 5, 4], [3, 5, 4], [0, 6, 10], [3, 6, 9]]
    G = create_graph(graph_vertices, graph_edges)
    qvm = create_qubo_model(G)
    p = 3
    q = 3
    optimizer_result = solve_qaoa(qvm, p, q)
    qc = create_qiskit_circuit(len(G.nodes), p, q, optimizer_result)
    n_shots = 1000
    counts = run_simulation(qc, n_shots)
    cut_value = calculate_cut_value(counts)

    circuit_depth = qc.depth()
    two_qubit_gate_count = qc.count_ops(QuantumGate('cx'))

    success_probability = counts[max(counts, key=counts.get)] / n_shots
    approximation_ratio = cut_value / qvm.objval()

    return approximation_ratio, success_probability, circuit_depth, two_qubit_gate_count, n_shots, len(optimizer_result), cut_value
